patches_added.name: Grammar Check Row
patches_added.description: Force the grammar check settings row to appear. The Phenotype flag that governs it never syncs on a patched build, so its compiled-in default (off) sticks.

patches_added.name: Suggested Settings
patches_added.description: Turns on flick keys for symbols, touch & hold keys for numbers, suggestion strip, grammar check and smart replies, and turns off block offensive words and word suggestions. Written once as defaults, so each can still be changed in Gboard's own settings.

patches_added.name: Toolbar Native Test
patches_added.description: Add a 'Test' button to the toolbar through Gboard's own access-point registry so drag reorder and persistence work natively. Writes 'test' at the cursor on tap. Architectural proof-of-concept; off by default.

patches_removed.name: Flick Keys for Symbols
patches_removed.description: Turn on Gboard's "Flick keys to enter symbols" — pull down on a key to enter the symbol hinted in its corner. Written once as a default, so it can still be turned off in Gboard's own settings.

patches_modified.name: Bigger Toolbar
patches_modified.description: Makes the number of icons on the toolbar above the keyboard adjustable, from Gboard's own settings. Anything past the limit stays in the overflow menu.

patches_modified.name: Toolbar Buttons
patches_modified.description: Add Select all, Copy and Paste buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, so each is one tap instead of opening Gboard's text editing panel first. Registered natively, so drag-to-reorder through the toolbar customize page persists.

patches_added.name: Flick Keys for Symbols
patches_added.description: Turn on Gboard's "Flick keys to enter symbols" — pull down on a key to enter the symbol hinted in its corner. Written once as a default, so it can still be turned off in Gboard's own settings.

patches_added.name: Select All Button
patches_added.description: Add a Select all button to the toolbar above the keyboard. One tap selects everything in the text field, without opening Gboard's text editing panel first.

patches_removed.name: Custom Hotkeys
patches_removed.description: Add up to 12 custom buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, each typing a string you write in Flexboard's settings. A slot stays invisible until you fill it in. Reorder them alongside Gboard's own buttons in its customise view. Disabled by default while reorder bugs are worked out.
